title: Let the error handler deal with missing posts
bug: Deleting a post that doesn't exist crashes with 500.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: Removing the explicit 404 abort causes db.session.get to return None, then accessing post.author raises AttributeError, resulting in a 500 error instead of the intended 404.

doppel_guided.summary: The PR introduces a regression: deleting a missing post now returns 500 instead of 404 because the code no longer aborts when the post is not found.

suspicions.claim: DELETE /posts/<id> returns 500 Internal Server Error instead of 404 when the post does not exist
suspicions.trigger: Send DELETE /api/posts/999999 with a valid Authorization Bearer token; read back status code and error response body
suspicions.evidence: DELETE /api/posts/999999 returned 404 in base and 500 in head, confirming the regression.
